paragraphs.txt.text: Fractions A fraction represents a part of a whole. The number below the line is the denominator and tells you how many equal parts the whole has been divided into. The number above the line is the numerator and tells you how many of those parts you have. Equivalent fractions Two fractions are equivalent when they represent the same amount.

lent fractions Two fractions are equivalent when they represent the same amount. Multiplying the numerator and the denominator by the same nonzero number always produces an equivalent fraction, because you are multiplying by a disguised form of one. Adding fractions To add two fractions they must share a denominator.

orm of one. Adding fractions To add two fractions they must share a denominator. Find the least common denominator, rewrite each fraction as an equivalent fraction over that denominator, then add the numerators and leave the denominator unchanged.

prose.txt.text: A linear equation in one variable can be written in the form ax + b = 0, where a and b are constants and a is not zero. Solving such an equation means finding the value of x that makes the statement true. The basic strategy is to isolate the variable on one side of the equals sign. You may add or subtract the same quantity from both sides without changing the solution.

add or subtract the same quantity from both sides without changing the solution. You may also multiply or divide both sides by any nonzero number. Each of these operations produces an equivalent equation, one with exactly the same solution set. When the variable appears on both sides, collect like terms first. Always check your answer by substituting it back into the original equation.

unicode.txt.text: The area of a circle is A = πr². For a right triangle, a² + b² = c², so c = √(a² + b²). Angles are measured in degrees (45°) or in radians (π/4 rad). Use × for multiplication and ÷ for division when writing by hand.
